name: Patricia Hill Collins
shortBio: American sociologist and social theorist whose landmark work Black Feminist Thought formalized intersectional epistemology, the 'outsider within' standpoint, and the 'matrix of domination'.
centralQuestion: How do interlocking systems of race, class, gender, and sexuality operate together as a matrix of domination while generating distinct subjugated knowledges?

keyWorks.title: Black Feminist Thought: Knowledge, Consciousness, and the Politics of Empowerment
keyWorks.description: Foundational treatise defining Black feminist epistemology, the matrix of domination, and dialogical validation of lived experiential knowledge.

keyWorks.title: Intersectionality as Critical Social Theory
keyWorks.description: Systematic philosophical and sociological account of intersectionality as an evolving critical social theory.
